7.1.18.2.2 Boolean type
For simple logical values, for their checks and for API return values the AUTOSAR type
boolean, defined in Platform_Types.h, can be used. For usage with this type, the
following values are also defined: TRUE, FALSE.
[SWS_BSW_00142] Allowed operations with boolean variables
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00378
⌈The only allowed operations with variables from type boolean are: assignment, re-
turn and test for equality, inequality and logical not with TRUE or FALSE.⌋
Note:
Compiler vendors that provide a boolean data type that cannot be disabled have to
change their compiler (i.e. make it ANSI C compliant).
Example: API returns boolean value
